links.comparator_used: Default ChatGPT 4.0 original responses with no reading-level instruction, compared with prompts asking to simplify and to respond at a 6th-grade level
links.outcome: Readability of ChatGPT 4.0 responses (Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level and Reading Ease)
links.effect: Grade Level: original 11.09 ± 1.47; simplified 8.16 ± 1.46; 6th-grade prompt 7.09 ± 1.23. Reading Ease: original 39.12 ± 8.25; simplified 51.53 ± 9.62; 6th-grade prompt 62.46 ± 7.48.
links.quote: Asking ChatGPT 4.0 to simplify or respond at a specific reading level may increase the readability of responses.
